name: compare_ctr_periods
description: Compares clicks, impressions and CTR of two equal-length periods from Google Search Console, splits the click change into an impressions component and a CTR component, and checks the dates against known Search Console reporting issues

arguments.name: prior
arguments.desc: Totals of the earlier period, for example from the Search Console Performance report

arguments.name: current
arguments.desc: Totals of the later period, for example from the Search Console Performance report

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: Where the numbers come from: gsc_ui_export (Search Console Performance report or its export), bulk_export (BigQuery bulk export), api (Search Console API) or other. Some reporting issues apply to one source only

name: project_clicks_at_ctr
description: Calculates the clicks a number of impressions would earn at a CTR you choose (impressions × CTR)

arguments.name: impressions
arguments.desc: Impressions of the period, a whole number

arguments.name: ctrPercent
arguments.desc: CTR as a percentage from 0 to 100: 3 means 3%, 0.5 means 0.5%. Not a fraction

name: impressions_needed_for_clicks
description: Calculates how many impressions a click target needs at a CTR you choose (clicks ÷ CTR)

arguments.name: clicks
arguments.desc: The click target, a whole number

arguments.name: ctrPercent
arguments.desc: CTR as a percentage from 0 to 100: 3 means 3%, 0.5 means 0.5%. Not a fraction

annotations.title: Impressions needed for a click target

name: check_gsc_reporting_issues
description: Lists the known Google Search Console reporting issues that overlap the dates you give, with the affected metrics and the source link

arguments.name: periods
arguments.desc: Up to four date ranges to check. Leave out to list every known issue

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: Where the numbers come from: gsc_ui_export (Search Console Performance report or its export), bulk_export (BigQuery bulk export), api (Search Console API) or other. Some reporting issues apply to one source only

annotations.title: Check known Search Console reporting issues
